source: Keystroke Product Catalogue (claude.ai artifact). Regenerate this file from the catalogue when products change.

practices.name: Count
practices.line: THE BUSINESS CAN SEE ITSELF IN TIME TO ACT
practices.intro: Data and reporting. Reports that build themselves, from the systems you already pay for.

practices.name: Clear
practices.line: THE WORK HAPPENS WITHOUT ANYONE DOING IT
practices.intro: Scheduled work and the crew. Details typed once, approvals routed, checks run overnight.

practices.name: Build
practices.line: A TOOL BUILT FOR HOW THIS BUSINESS RUNS
practices.intro: Software and web. Forms, apps, portals and sites built in code for how you work.

practices.name: Face
practices.line: THE BUSINESS LOOKS LIKE WHAT IT HAS BECOME
practices.intro: Brand and design. From the logo to the email signature, one system.

products.name: Monthly reporting pack
products.headline: Month-end takes a week, and the report arrives too late to act on.
products.whatWeBuild: A monthly pack built from the accounting system: profit and loss, cash, debtors and margin by job type, refreshed on the first business day. One page per question the owner asks.
products.forWho: Any business of 5–50 staff on Xero or MYOB; strongest fit for trades and professional services.
products.deliverable: A Power BI report, a PDF pack emailed on the first business day, and a one-page guide to reading it.
products.worksWith: Accounting system (Xero or MYOB)

products.name: Job costing report
products.headline: You find out what a job made after it is finished.
products.whatWeBuild: Quoted against actual hours, materials and margin for every open job, updated daily from the job system and the accounting system.
products.forWho: Trades, construction and manufacturing running job management software.
products.deliverable: A live job margin report with an overrun list each morning.
products.worksWith: Job management system and accounting system

products.name: Daily numbers board
products.headline: Nobody knows this week's numbers until Friday.
products.whatWeBuild: One screen with jobs booked, quotes out, cash in and overdue invoices, refreshed overnight and readable on a phone.
products.forWho: Owner-operators who check the bank balance to know how the week went.
products.deliverable: A dashboard link and a 7am summary email.
products.worksWith: Accounting system and job or CRM system

products.name: Spreadsheet rebuild
products.headline: One spreadsheet runs the business, and only one person understands it.
products.whatWeBuild: The workbook the business depends on, rebuilt to hold: inputs separated from calculations, validation on every entry, Power Query in place of copy and paste, and a written guide.
products.forWho: Any business with a critical Excel file older than its newest staff member.
products.deliverable: The rebuilt workbook, a change log and a one-page guide.
products.worksWith: Excel version and the systems the data comes from

products.name: Cash-flow forecast
products.headline: The bank balance is the forecast.
products.whatWeBuild: A rolling 13-week forecast built from open invoices, bills and payroll, refreshed weekly, with a debtor chase list.
products.forWho: Businesses with lumpy project income or slow-paying clients.
products.deliverable: The forecast workbook or report, and a weekly chase list.
products.worksWith: Accounting system and payroll

products.name: Utilisation report
products.headline: Billable hours get counted at month-end, by hand.
products.whatWeBuild: Billable against non-billable hours by person, client and job, from the timesheet system, refreshed daily.
products.forWho: Professional services: accountants, engineers, consultants, agencies.
products.deliverable: A utilisation report and a monthly write-off list.
products.worksWith: Timesheet or practice management system

products.name: Job-to-invoice link
products.headline: The invoices get typed twice.
products.whatWeBuild: A finished job writes its own draft invoice in the accounting system. Nobody re-keys the customer, the line items or the job number.
products.forWho: Trades and service businesses with a job system and a separate accounting system.
products.deliverable: The working link, a short test log, and a page on what to do when it fails.
products.worksWith: Job system and accounting system, both with API access

products.name: Inbox intake
products.headline: Supplier bills and quote requests sit in an inbox until someone types them in.
products.whatWeBuild: A crew unit reads incoming email and attachments, pulls out the details, files the document in SharePoint and creates a draft bill or job request for a person to check. Not a person.
products.forWho: Any business that receives more than 20 bills or enquiries a week by email.
products.deliverable: The running unit, a daily exceptions list, and its running total.
products.worksWith: Email platform (Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace), file storage and accounting system

products.name: Approvals routing
products.headline: Things wait in an inbox for approval.
products.whatWeBuild: Purchase orders, quotes over a set value and leave requests are routed to the right person in Teams or Outlook with one-tap approve, and every decision is logged.
products.forWho: Businesses of 10–50 staff where the owner signs off everything.
products.deliverable: The approval flows and a decision log.
products.worksWith: Microsoft 365 (Teams and Power Automate licences)

products.name: Document generation
products.headline: Every quote, contract and safety document starts as a copy of the last one.
products.whatWeBuild: A form or a job record fills a branded Word or PDF template: quotes, contracts, SWMS, reports. The document is filed and named without anyone touching it.
products.forWho: Trades, construction and professional services producing repeat documents.
products.deliverable: The templates, the generator and a filing structure.
products.worksWith: Microsoft 365 and wherever the job data lives

products.name: Systems link-up
products.headline: Five systems that don't talk to each other.
products.whatWeBuild: Customers, jobs and invoices kept in step between the CRM, the job system and the accounting system, with one home for each record.
products.forWho: Businesses running three or more systems that each hold a copy of the customer.
products.deliverable: The integration, a map of which system owns which record, and a failure alert.
products.worksWith: Every system involved, and whether each one offers API access

products.name: Overnight reconciliation
products.headline: Someone matches the bank feed by hand every Monday.
products.whatWeBuild: A crew unit matches bank lines to invoices and bills overnight and leaves an exceptions list at 7am. Not a person.
products.forWho: Businesses with high transaction volume and a bookkeeper doing it by hand.
products.deliverable: The running unit and a morning exceptions list.
products.worksWith: Accounting system and bank feeds

products.name: Client onboarding run
products.headline: Every new client means the same 20 setup steps.
products.whatWeBuild: One form starts the lot: SharePoint folder, accounting contact, welcome email, task list for the team.
products.forWho: Professional services and agencies taking on new clients every month.
products.deliverable: The form, the flow and a checklist of what it does.
products.worksWith: Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace and accounting system

products.name: Lead research run
products.headline: Prospecting is someone searching the web at night.
products.whatWeBuild: Agents research, enrich and score target businesses into a register, and draft a first email for each one for a person to review and send.
products.forWho: B2B businesses that sell to other small businesses.
products.deliverable: A scored lead register and reviewed draft emails per batch.
products.worksWith: CRM or email platform

products.name: Online quote and booking form
products.headline: Bookings are by phone only, and quotes need a site visit to see the job.
products.whatWeBuild: A web form with photo upload that writes the job straight into the job system or a SharePoint list and confirms to the customer.
products.forWho: Trades and services where the phone is the only way in.
products.deliverable: The form on their site and the job appearing where they already work.
products.worksWith: Website platform and job system

products.name: Website build
products.headline: The website looks like the business it was five years ago.
products.whatWeBuild: A new site built in code by Keystroke, or in WordPress with Elementor on hosting the client owns.
products.forWho: Any business whose site is slow, not built for phones, or does not take enquiries.
products.deliverable: The site, hosting set up, and either a care retainer or one hour of training.
products.worksWith: Domain, hosting and email setup

products.name: Website quiz with recommendation
products.headline: Visitors leave without saying what they need.
products.whatWeBuild: A short quiz that scores the answers, writes back a plain recommendation in under 200 words, and logs the lead.
products.forWho: Service businesses whose enquiry form gets empty or vague messages.
products.deliverable: The quiz on their site and a lead log.
products.worksWith: Website platform

products.name: Job and time tracking app
products.headline: Timesheets are on paper, or in a tool nobody uses.
products.whatWeBuild: A phone-first app built for how this crew logs time, materials and photos against a job. Feeds the job costing report.
products.forWho: Trades and field crews of 5–30.
products.deliverable: The app, accounts for the crew, and a one-page guide.
products.worksWith: Job system and payroll or accounting system

products.name: Client portal
products.headline: Clients ring to ask where their job is up to.
products.whatWeBuild: A login page where each client sees job status, documents and invoices, pulled from the systems the business already uses.
products.forWho: Builders, engineers and agencies with long-running jobs.
products.deliverable: The portal and client accounts.
products.worksWith: Job system, document storage and accounting system

products.name: Quote calculator
products.headline: Every quote is worked out from scratch in a spreadsheet.
products.whatWeBuild: An estimator using the business's own rates and rules that produces a quote PDF in a minute. Internal, or on the website for customers.
products.forWho: Businesses with repeatable pricing: fencing, cleaning, landscaping, fabrication.
products.deliverable: The calculator and the quote template.
products.worksWith: Website platform and current pricing spreadsheets

products.name: Cookie-free site analytics
products.headline: Nobody knows which pages bring in enquiries.
products.whatWeBuild: Site analytics built and hosted for the business, with no cookies and no advertising trackers, reporting the pages that lead to enquiries.
products.forWho: Businesses on a Keystroke-built site.
products.deliverable: A monthly page report.
products.worksWith: Website hosting (Keystroke-built sites)

products.name: Brand redesign
products.headline: The logo was made when the business was three people.
products.whatWeBuild: A redesigned brand: logo, colour and type, drawn on a grid and applied to the website and the documents the business sends.
products.forWho: Businesses that have grown past their original look, or are about to tender, hire or raise prices.
products.deliverable: Logo files for print, screen and social, a colour and type set, and the brand applied to the site and three core documents.

products.name: Style guide
products.headline: Nobody can say which logo, colour or font is the right one.
products.whatWeBuild: A short brand guide: logo use, clear space, colour values, type, tone of voice and examples of right and wrong, as a PDF and a web page.
products.forWho: Businesses with a brand that gets used by staff, printers, sign-writers and agencies.
products.deliverable: The style guide as PDF and web page, plus a one-page summary for suppliers.

products.name: Design system
products.headline: The website, documents and social posts each look slightly different.
products.whatWeBuild: Colour, type and spacing tokens and a set of components (buttons, forms, cards, tables), documented so every page and document is built from the same parts.
products.forWho: Businesses with a website, an app or several people producing material.
products.deliverable: Token file, component library, written rules and a paste-ready CSS block for the site.
products.worksWith: Website platform and Office setup

products.name: Business cards
products.headline: The cards still have the old logo and a fax number.
products.whatWeBuild: Front and back designed in the brand, set up print-ready at 90 × 55 mm for every staff member, with the print order handled if wanted.
products.forWho: Any business whose staff meet clients in person.
products.deliverable: Print-ready PDFs per person and a template for new staff. Printing is paid by the client.

products.name: Stationery set
products.headline: Letters go out on a Word document with the logo pasted in.
products.whatWeBuild: Letterhead, compliments slip, DL envelope and labels designed in the brand, delivered print-ready and as editable Word files.
products.forWho: Businesses that still post letters, quotes or contracts.
products.deliverable: Print-ready files and editable Word letterhead.

products.name: Email signatures
products.headline: Every email signature in the business is different.
products.whatWeBuild: One HTML signature in the brand, with name, role, phone and logo, installed for every mailbox in Outlook or Gmail.
products.forWho: Any business with more than one mailbox.
products.deliverable: The signature installed for each mailbox and a template for new staff.
products.worksWith: Email platform (Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace)

products.name: Document templates
products.headline: Every staff member's quote looks different.
products.whatWeBuild: Word and PowerPoint templates and the quote and invoice layouts inside the accounting system, all built from one brand system.
products.forWho: Any business sending quotes, reports and proposals to clients.
products.deliverable: The template set and a one-page usage guide.
products.worksWith: Microsoft Office version and accounting system invoice themes

products.name: Tender and capability pack
products.headline: Every tender is written from a blank page.
products.whatWeBuild: A capability statement, an EOI template and a bank of reusable answers, laid out so the next tender starts at 80% done.
products.forWho: Construction, engineering and services firms bidding for government and commercial work.
products.deliverable: The capability statement, templates and answer bank.
